evidence: Homepage shows "Showing 8 jobs" with full list of listings.
Industry=Healthcare filtered to 1 job (Registered Nurse), Job Type=Contract filtered to 1 job (DevOps Engineer), Location=Chicago,IL filtered to 1 job (Data Analyst).
Typing "Nurse" in search box updated results to "Showing 1 jobs" - Registered Nurse.
Each filter/search change updated the job list immediately without needing a submit action.
Each job card displays title, company, location, salary range, industry, type, posted date, and skills tags.
Job details page shows title, company, location, salary, posted date, full description with responsibilities/requirements, and required skills tags.

Submitting empty form triggers "Please fill out this field" on required Name/Email/Message; submitting with malformed email "not-an-email" triggers "Please include an '@' in the email address" and blocks submission.
Filled Name/Email/Phone/Message on job-1 details page and submitted successfully with toast "Application submitted!".
Application submission returned success notification without error; form reset after submission.

actual: Submitted a second application to job-1 using the identical name/email/phone as a prior successful application; the system accepted it again showing "Application submitted!" with no warning or blocking of the duplicate submission.

evidence: Employer Dashboard "Your Job Listings" section lists 5 posted jobs with industry, type, location, salary, posted date.
Clicking the applications count button (4) for Senior Frontend Developer expanded an "Applications (4)" list with applicant details for that specific job.
Applications list shows each applicant's name (Jane Applicant, Alex Johnson, Maria Garcia), email, phone, message, and submission date - clearly distinguished per applicant.

Clicking "Post Job" with all fields empty did not navigate away/create a listing; the Job Title field shows browser validation message "Please fill out this field." and remains focused, blocking submission.

Filled title, industry, type, location, salary range, description, and a skill; clicked Post Job -> toast "Job posted successfully!" and new listing "QA Automation Engineer" appeared in dashboard job list.

issue: Missing edit functionality for job listings
actual: Delete works (confirmation dialog removes the job and updates Active Jobs count from 6 to 5), but no Edit control exists anywhere in the dashboard: each job row only has an applications-count button and a delete (trash) icon button; clicking the job title does not navigate to an edit form, and no button has edit-related text/aria-label in the DOM.

issue: No role-based access control preventing job seekers from posting jobs
actual: The application has no login/authentication or role distinction between employers and job seekers. The "Post a Job" link and /employer/post-job form are freely accessible to any visitor from the main navigation, and a new job was successfully created without any employer identity verification, so job seekers are not blocked from posting job openings.
